obligations.stimulus: Every inventoried detail extension, multi-declarators, suffix-only and As forms, Optional/rank/defaults, modifiers/attributes and call Group/Omitted/NamedArgument witnesses.
obligations.oracle: Both source-built stages publish exact independently authored details/spans while every prior logical syntax projection, rejection/defer and resource gate remains unchanged.
obligations.measurement: Native observed records and complete source/token comparisons, not inventory snippet matches.

obligations.stimulus: All cases.json sources through the actual UBE checker and explicit UBECore Reference; include the owner-confirmed contextual/default literal boundaries.
obligations.oracle: Complete independently expected declaration bindings, types, values, conversions, call modes/maps, primary/related spans and outcome categories through both stages; no expected output generated by the checker.
obligations.measurement: A comparator validates the complete result graph and all stated facts; mutations of binding, type, value, alias mode, call order, error/defer and spans must fail.

obligations.stimulus: Start with a nontrivial old result and different source owners; inject real allocation/root denial at declaration construction, folding/decoding, body work, preparation and publication; include failure before procedure entry.
obligations.oracle: Fresh failure status, byte/identity-equivalent complete old graph and old owners alive, no partial new publication and no stale-Err success inference.
obligations.measurement: Sweep every observed failure site through both stages; track real root/payload counts and retry outcomes, not synthetic Boolean failures alone.

obligations.stimulus: Invalid negative/excessive values; zero, required-minus-one, exact-required and required-plus-one declaration/fact/pending/depth budgets; flat and deep expressions and many distinct names.
obligations.oracle: Separate invalid-domain, caller-budget and storage outcomes; exact inclusive budget semantics, forward progress and unchanged old result; flat chains cannot overflow the native stack.
obligations.measurement: Actual emitted/pending counts and peak depth through both stages; all scratch/discarded work accounted.

obligations.stimulus: Same complete project at jobs 1/2/4, repeated and forced/reversed worker completion, uneven bodies and multiple independent errors/deferred witnesses.
obligations.oracle: Identical complete bindings/types/conversions/call maps/source identities and canonical first diagnostic; one total budget and private body results, no completion-order identity.
obligations.measurement: Observed overlap/admission/completion, live worker maximum and complete serialized comparisons against independent facts and the one-job reference.

obligations.stimulus: Cancel before admission, during signature/body work, and before publication; actual start/wait failure with workers already admitted.
obligations.oracle: Every admitted worker drains; old result/owners remain usable; no partial publication, orphan threads, roots, buffers or external handles.
obligations.measurement: Actual liveness/waits/root/payload/handle observations, repeated recovery and a subsequent successful check.

obligations.stimulus: Four simultaneous project contexts share immutable inputs but have distinct declarations/old outputs/budgets/errors.
obligations.oracle: No mutable lookup, diagnostics, result or Err leakage between contexts; source owners survive their last reader.
obligations.measurement: Actual UBE workers and poisoned-release/borrow watches; reject a deliberately unowned borrow as negative control.

obligations.stimulus: Destination-context/default Long/LongLong boundaries, representable literals wider than the destination, initializer versus separate assignment (40000 - 10000 into Integer), suffix overrides, signed/grouped minima, known final overflow and division by zero in ordinary assignments, and runtime-dependent checked operations; short-circuit calls with observable effects for the later executable gate.
obligations.oracle: Literal types hold their values; the calculated result is converted afterward. Literal-only integer subtrees become typed constants at every optimization level, preserving checked types, grouping and original spans. Provable faults are compile-time diagnostics in ordinary initializers/assignments too. Declaration precedes initializer evaluation, supports self-reference to neutral storage, and survives recoverable runtime initializer failure; source evaluation order and skipped-operand policy survive lowering.
obligations.measurement: The native checker comparator must inspect actual folded constant nodes/values and the absence of runtime arithmetic for those subtrees, including inside runtime expressions; merely accepting a compile-time-folded label is insufficient. Actual initializer/split-assignment equivalence, retained variable storage, Err/neutral results, exact-once effects and aliases require native programs in the later checked-executable deliverable; no execution claim from semantic records.

obligations.stimulus: Byte/Integer/Long native declarations in user and explicit library modules; renamed pack/unpack procedures, illegal representation conversions, wrong/duplicate metadata and cross-module bindings.
obligations.oracle: Nominal identity and explicit exact bindings; no spelling-based builtin behavior or exposed storage; unsupported representations stay deferred.
obligations.measurement: Independent semantic result/diagnostic comparisons; later native ABI/copy/Err behavior remains a separate executable gate.

obligations.stimulus: Increasing flat/deep programs, many identifiers and uses, long Unicode names, collision-heavy names, multiple modules and retained old results under jobs 1/2/4.
obligations.oracle: Zero worker source-payload copies, geometric bounded growth, no repeated full-module lookup scan or per-append full-array/project copy, bounded peak retained memory and complete cleanup.
obligations.measurement: Instrument real reads/fold scalars/comparisons/probes/writes/allocations/copied and zeroed bytes/roots; preset representation-specific constants in reviewed probes before production implementation. Report collision bounds separately.

obligations.stimulus: Run bootstrap/build-v2.ps1 and maintained parser, source/local/project CLI, borrowed-lifetime and concurrency gates after production changes.
obligations.oracle: All applicable earlier independent assertions and unchanged frontend behavior pass for the exact new source/tool/artifact cohort; both raw LLVM stages compare under the existing policy.
obligations.measurement: Record exact commands, reports, hashes and limitations; historical 785-source assertions are not a rerun.

obligations.stimulus: Before changing --check, review concrete message/code integration and process oracles for checked-subset, semantic error, deferred, frontend, domain, budget, cancellation and storage results.
obligations.oracle: Existing unsupported semantic diagnostic stays until actual implementation qualification; bounded success emits no executable and never claims complete-language validity. Allocation-free diagnostics retain safe fallbacks.
obligations.measurement: Exact process status/stdout/stderr/source-span cases and diagnostic resource failures; no unspecified numeric diagnostic ABI introduced by this definition.
